title: Shinonome Ena — Featuring KUROMI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm logging off now!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're gonna work on that picture, right? Let me see it when you're done!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, okay. See you later.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! First let me transfer the image from my phone, and then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh! Now that I can use layers, maybe I'll redo the coloring.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The lines for the clothes are also a bit messy. I'll clean up the spots that are crooked and overlapping while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I never get to draw just for fun like this. I feel so at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But even if I finish, I guess Mizuki and the others are the only ones who'll see it.)
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ngh...
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I finished my drawing and uploaded it to Nightcord...
And then...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I accidentally pressed something on my phone as I was dozing off. I should head back—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That light, it's just like befor—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah! What the—?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, what the heck was that? Wait...
Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Where the heck is this?! All of this is way too bizarre for me to handle!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, my phone flashed and I suddenly found myself here...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone, be quiet. Something is coming toward us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: L-Let's hide behind that thing over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hang on a sec, Mafuyu. What's coming toward us? Where is it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I couldn't see it very well...
But it's over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's floating!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What the—?! What is that thing?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shhh! Don't be so loud!
Hm? Somebody there?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Eep! L-Leave us alone!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Waaah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, you! Aren't you...
Kuromi?

rows.Speaker: Ena & Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Aw what, you're just humans? Your shouting scared the heck out of me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Are you really...
Kuromi?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, this place we've all fallen into is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Looks that way. That's what I heard from someone else though, so I'm not totally sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right. Well, we've got a general grasp on the situation now. Thanks, Ms. Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Just Kuromi's fine! We don't gotta be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Then, great to meet you, Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Great to meetcha, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Ena, you should show her your drawing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? You want me to show it to the real deal?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Hm? Whatcha talkin' about?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We went to Puroland today, and Ena colored in a picture of you.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Oh really? I trust you captured my beauty on the page?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, I never skimp when it comes to art.
Here.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
Let's see...
What the—?! What is this?!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I'm in a fashion show modeling a super cool Lolita dress?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow...
So this is how it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even though the original picture was just Kuromi herself.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Huh?! So these clothes and this background were...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All drawn by Ena. I just helped give ideas for the clothing design, and she put it all together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The original picture showed you looking confident, so I thought up some different scenarios to fit with it till I landed on this one.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Luh—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Luh?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Luuuuv it!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Ena, Mizuki! You guys are amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well I have some experience drawing, and I am studying art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But everyone else is just as impressive.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The four of us make original songs together and post them online. Kanade composes, Mafuyu makes the mix and lyrics and Mizuki does the video editing.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Songs?! You guys make music?! By yourselves?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Our group is called Nightcord at 25:00.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Whoa! You guys are just too cool!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: I like you guys! Feel free to hang out here as long as you want!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kuromi, did you not just arrive here, same as us?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Who cares about the details?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: More importantly, you guys seem like you've got a lot of interesting stories.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: And just when I was starting to get bored! So come on, tell me more about yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, do you wanna see the pictures we took at Puroland?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Puroland? That's kinda same old same old to me. Got any others?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
Like maybe...
Ooh! Pictures of hot guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hot guys?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She likes good-looking guys. It said that in her profile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right, it did.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmmm, good-looking guy pics...
Aha! How about these guys?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wha— Mizuki! That's Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Waaah! These guys are super hot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The one on the right is Ena's Li'l Bro.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: For real?!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: You get to have a brother this good-looking?! No fair!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? He's way too arrogant. You can have him.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: You don't know how good you have it! Now, who's this other guy? C'mon tell me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, okay. This one's named Toya. He's Akito's singing partner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And my classmate♪

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Y-You get to go to class with a guy this cute?! So, you see him at school every day?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, uh...
I would, if I actually went...

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Wha—?! Are you all surrounded by dreamy guys you don't appreciate?!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
Don't tell me...
You too?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Uhhh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come on now, don't hassle them. You wanna hear about Akito and Toya, don't you?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Ah! That's right! Come on then, gimme the details!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, all right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Times like this, Ena's big sister side really shows.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right?!
